items.title: Vibe-Coded Browser Ports Of Games Work Perfectly, Unfortunately
items.excerpt: Call of Duty: Black Ops, Halo: CE, GTA: Vice City, Skate 3 and more were decompiled and ported to web browsers overnight with AI coding agents, and they appear to run well.
items.rationale: New event: AI coding agents decompiled and ported Black Ops, Halo CE, GTA Vice City and other games to the browser overnight, and the ports run. It is a step beyond the single-game recomp fights covered before, both in scale and in IP risk.

items.title: '여동생 운전 가르치기' 게임, AI 사용료만 하루 135만 원
items.excerpt: LLM 기반 스팀 게임 '여동생 운전 가르치기'가 데모 이용자 급증으로 하루 1,000달러에 달하는 AI 모델 사용료를 감당하지 못해 대출까지 받았고, 모델 전환으로 품질 저하 논란도 겪고 있다.
items.rationale: A concrete number: an LLM-driven Steam demo's inference bill hit about $1,000 a day, the developer took out a loan, and switching to a cheaper model drew complaints about quality. It is a cautionary case for anyone designing live-LLM gameplay.

items.title: Dreamlands opens its AI 3D world-building platform to the public
items.excerpt: Dreamlands is publicly launching its 1.0 platform, giving anyone a way to generate game-ready 3D assets and entire worlds with AI.
items.rationale: New release: Dreamlands 1.0 opens to the public and generates game-ready 3D assets and whole worlds from AI. Environment artists and level designers can try it now.

items.title: PlayStation creator turned AI CEO Ken Kutaragi predicts AI daydreams will replace video games
items.excerpt: Ken Kutaragi told 4Gamer that real-time AI generation of video and music will run at console speed around 2028-29, turning 'imagination itself' into content and replacing games as we know them.
items.rationale: PlayStation creator Ken Kutaragi, now an AI CEO, gives a dated forecast: real-time generated video and music at console speed by 2028-29, which he says will displace games as we know them. It is a concrete marker from one of the industry's architects.

items.title: 크래프톤, 서울대와 게임·로봇 AI 월드모델 공동연구 시작
items.excerpt: 크래프톤이 서울대학교와 게임·로봇 분야 월드모델 공동연구에 착수했다. 향후 3년간 공동연구센터를 운영하며 가상과 현실을 이해·예측하는 AI를 고도화한다.
items.rationale: New announcement: Krafton and Seoul National University are opening a three-year joint research center on world models for games and robotics. It puts a major Korean publisher behind the world-model race.
